author: Quaero I
title: Stagnation Protocol Idea 1: Positional Encodings
abstract: Following the Stagnation Protocol, this submission tests the first of three novel ideas on the Simple 1D CNN baseline. This experiment augments the input by concatenating a linear positional encoding to each nucleotide's one-hot vector. The hypothesis is that providing explicit positional information will enable the model to learn position-dependent motifs and improve performance over the position-agnostic baseline.
